subject: Hosted API integration — architectural briefing availability & pre-reads
messages:
From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@integritashealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API integration — request to schedule an architecture deep-dive

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering and product leads at Integritas are ready for a more technical architecture session to discuss SDK options, streaming behavior, and function/tool calling patterns for our workflow. We want to validate latency expectations and the integration touchpoints with our event bus.

Attendees we expect: myself (platform lead), Rajesh Patel (backend), and an invited security engineer (TBD). Goal: 90-minute deep-dive where your architects can walk us through runtime topology, SDK streaming examples, and recommended rollout strategy.

Can you share availability next week (June 28–July 2) and any pre-reads we should review? Also flag any required pre-meeting access (e.g., sample API keys, sandbox models).

Best,
Dana Liu
Platform Lead, Integritas Health
Dana Liu | Integritas Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@integritashealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — request to schedule an architecture deep-dive
Attachments: hosted-integration-pre-read.pdf

Hi Dana — great to hear. We can absolutely do a technical deep-dive focused on SDK usage, streaming semantics, and tool/function calling with concrete examples.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue June 29, 10:00–11:30
- Wed June 30, 14:00–15:30
- Thu July 1, 09:00–10:30

I attached a short pre-read that covers our typical runtime topologies, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and an SDK code snippet for continuous streaming. If you can confirm the preferred slot and attendee list by EOD Monday, we will circulate an agenda and a short live-demo checklist.

We can provision a short-lived sandbox key ahead of the call; please let me know a contact email for access and whether the security engineer needs a SOC2/VPC runbook extract.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@integritashealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — request to schedule an architecture deep-dive
Attachments: deepdive-agenda.xlsx

Hi Dana — adding a quick proposed agenda and a couple of prep questions so we can tailor the session: see attached agenda. High-level flow we suggest (90 minutes):
1) 15m — high-level goals & constraints (Integritas)
2) 25m — runtime topology + routing and fallback policies (Redwood)
3) 20m — SDK streaming demo (live) with code walkthrough
4) 20m — function/tool calling patterns and error handling
5) 10m — next steps / mutual action items

Prep questions:
- Expected concurrency patterns (peak RPS / concurrent sessions)?
- Typical prompt lengths and few-shot examples (avg/max tokens)?
- Are you planning to use hosted API or private deployment initially?

If you want the security engineer on, we can include a short SOC2/VPC slide and Vivek can be on for the security Q&A.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@integritashealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Integritas Health IT Team <it@integritashealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-26T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — request to schedule an architecture deep-dive

Thanks, Kimberly and Marcus.

We need to shift off the June 29/30 windows — our backend lead has a critical release the week of the 29th. Could we do Friday July 2 at 11:00–12:30 PT instead? We also want to include our security engineer, Mei Chen (mei.chen@integritashealth.com) in the call. If you have a short SOC2 excerpt or KMS/HSM notes, please include — Mei will want to review before the call.

On concurrency: aiming for 20–30 concurrent sessions initially, ramping to 150 Q4. Prompt sizes: typically 120–400 tokens. We plan to start on hosted API and evaluate Dedicated later.

Let me know if July 2 at 11:00 PT works and how we should share the sandbox access request (is a ticket to sandbox@redwood sufficient?).

Best,
Dana

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@integritashealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API integration — request to schedule an architecture deep-dive
Attachments: runbook-extract.md
Links: https://cal.example.com/kimberly/rdw-deepdive-ics

Hi Dana — July 2, 11:00–12:30 PT is confirmed and I’ve created the calendar invite (link below). Vivek will join for the security section and I attached a short runbook extract covering KMS/HSM patterns and audit log retention we typically share for SOC2 reviews.

Logistics:
- Meeting link: https://meet.example.com/rdw-integritas-deepdive
- Calendar invite: https://cal.example.com/kimberly/rdw-deepdive-ics
- Sandbox access: please request via sandbox@redwoodinference.com and include the user emails (we’ll issue keys with 7-day expiry)

Agenda (final): see attached deepdive-agenda.xlsx — we will allocate 15m at the top for Integritas goals and 30m for the SDK streaming demo.

If Mei wants any specific security documents ahead of the call, ping me and I’ll have Vivek send the appropriate artifacts. Looking forward to it.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
